description: This file defines the StartupWmClassEntry class and the XpropWindowDialog class, which are used for identifying window classes via xprop in a GTK-based application, specifically part of MenuLibre menu editor.

classes.name: StartupWmClassEntry
classes.description: A text entry widget that allows identifying window classes using xprop.

classes.name: XpropWindowDialog
classes.description: A GTK dialog for running xprop to retrieve window class information.

methods.name: StartupWmClassEntry.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the widget, sets icon and tooltip, and connects icon press event.

methods.name: StartupWmClassEntry._on_icon_press
methods.description: Handles icon press event to run the xprop dialog and update the window class.

methods.name: XpropWindowDialog.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the dialog for identifying window classes.

methods.name: XpropWindowDialog.run_xprop
methods.description: Starts the xprop process, runs the dialog, and returns sorted window classes.

methods.name: XpropWindowDialog.start_xprop
methods.description: Launches the xprop subprocess to get WM_CLASS data.

methods.name: XpropWindowDialog.check_xprop
methods.description: Checks the subprocess output, parses window class names, and updates the list.
